primary_source.site_type: Docusaurus rules wiki, community-maintained, active through Aug 2026 blog posts
primary_source.note: The rules CONTENT is faithful to published Mordheim (core rulebook + Town Cryer / Mordheim Annual / official supplements). The CONSOLIDATION, cross-referencing, and any house-ruling markers (the '✏️' pencil-edit icon and '❓' clarification icon seen throughout the site) are community work, not GW. Tagged inline in the note where it matters.

pages_not_read_deliberately: /docs/weapons-armour/close-combat and /docs/weapons-armour/missile — attempted; the close-combat page alone is a 73k-char catalogue of every melee weapon across every warband (core + all supplements). A naive regex extraction of it produced WRONG cost figures (e.g. Dagger '15gc', Kitchen Knife '40gc') that do not match the core rulebook. Correct core weapon costs were instead pulled from the Living Rulebook PDF's Mercenary Equipment List (p.52) and cross-checked against /docs/weapons-armour/armour, which DID scrape cleanly. Do not re-attempt a bulk regex parse of the close-combat page without manually verifying every value against a second source — logged so a future pass doesn't repeat the mistake.
primary_source.faqs_page_note: The /docs/faqs page (86.9k chars) is a Q&A compendium of rules-clarification rulings (mostly Tuomas Pirinen Facebook posts and Mordheim Annual/Town Cryer FAQ answers), organised by rules topic (Movement, Charging, Combat, Psychology, Weapons & Armour, Warbands, Scenarios, Objectives, Border Town Burning, etc.). It is overwhelmingly warband-specific rules-lawyering (e.g. 'do Hired Swords count +5 in warband rating') rather than mechanic-level content. Skimmed via targeted keyword search (Serious Injury, Rating, Rout, Psychology, Stupidity) rather than read in full; confirmed no divergence from the core rules captured elsewhere in this run. Full-text search performed with Python over the raw scrape, not manually read top to bottom — flagging depth honestly.
